scope: Authenticated organization/discovered dashboard, production Next.js and real rstream producer tunnel. Adaptive MediaMTX 1.21.1 or direct WebRTC, native headless Chromium on macOS. Producer process already running; initial source low, MediaMTX cycles medium after a shared change. GitHub membership is a fixture; OAuth, physical capture/display and a forced relay path are excluded. MediaMTX resolver callbacks use the local stack temporary HTTPS tunnel; this is not the future deployed topology.
measurement: First observed unobstructed video frame callback, after the loading overlay disappears. The later of expected display time and observation after visibility checks is a conservative startup estimate. Exact first submission is reported separately; historical failed trials remain failed.
lifecycle: Actual offline device selection unmounts the player and invokes its normal WHEP DELETE. Reactivation selects the live device on the same page after encoder idle. MediaMTX uses its production 5-second runOnDemandCloseAfter. Encoder idle is observed by bounded HTTP polling and includes polling/control latency. Abrupt browser loss is not measured here.
limitations: Small finite sample, not a percentile or startup SLA.
First activation includes adapter startup; same-page restart still recreates the adapter after idle.
Source process startup and actual target capture/network/hardware remain separate qualification.

attempts.note: initial probe, late mutation delivery invalidates same-page measurement
